item.content:encoded:

Advanced Pelvic Floor: Pelvic Pain (WHTA)

Bio

Nicole has been professionally involved in the health and fitness industry since 2014. Nicole personally embarked on her own rehabilitation journey during her time at The Australian Ballet School back in 2009-2012. This extensive and comprehensive ballet training from a young age made Nicole highly aware of human physiology and the benefits of exercise rehabilitation.  

Since then she has graduated with a Bachelor of Physiotherapy with distinction (2021), Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology (2016) and a Diploma of Pilates Movement Therapy (2016). Nicole has completed additional training with both WHTA and APA and holds Level 1 & 2 Women’s Pelvic Health certification.

Nicole has worked in both public and private sectors across a variety of areas including sport, pelvic health and musculoskeletal. Her passion is using exercise as medicine to support people through their journey of health and ageing. With Nicole's wide range of skills and experience she has the confidence to tailor and adapt any treatment plan to meet the needs of each and every person regardless of exercise experience, abilities and pre-existing injuries or health concerns.

Nicole’s patients love her vibrant and enthusiastic approach to instructing and educating. No two exercise programs are ever the same, with Nicole individualising and personalising each aspect to fit each patient's health objectives and goals. 

When Nicole isn’t at work, she enjoys getting out doors, trying new restaurants and relaxing river walks with her pup, Jeff.

**You may be lucky to meet the clinic dog - Jeff. He is extremely friendly and just wants to say hello to all the patients, then will go back to sleep on the sunny driveway. If you are not a dog person, don’t stress, he can nap in another room!

Laura Bradford

Qualifications

Physiotherapist

Pelvic Health Physiotherapist

Clinical Pilates Instructor

Relevant Post Graduate Training

Women’s Pelvic Health Physiotherapy Level 1 (APA)

Bio

Laura's affinity for health and wellness has been ongoing throughout her life, characterised by her enthusiastic participation in multiple sporting teams, and her regular attendance at the gym and aerobics classes. She has always prioritised physical well-being.

Her journey into physiotherapy was sparked by a personal experience with a back injury, during which she discovered physiotherapy and pilates. Inspired by this, she pursued and completed a Diploma in Pilates, subsequently transitioning into teaching clinical pilates alongside a team of esteemed Physiotherapists. Building on this foundation, she completed a Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy, graduating with distinction. Laura has completed additional training with both WHTA and APA and holds Level 1 Women’s Pelvic Health certification.

Laura's expertise in exercise prescription enriches her approach to physiotherapy, allowing her to tailor treatments effectively. She has accumulated experience in working with a diverse clientele, including peri-natal women, individuals facing cancer, those managing chronic back pain, athletes recovering from sporting injuries, individuals undergoing pre and post-surgery rehabilitation and vestibular dysfunction (dizziness, vertigo and balance problems). Additionally, Laura's firsthand experience navigating the peri-natal journey equips her with invaluable insight, further enhancing her ability to connect with and support clients. Her compassionate nature fosters deep connections with clients, enabling her to understand and address their unique needs with empathy and care.

Beyond her professional endeavours, Laura finds joy in spending time with her husband Zac and caring for their son Theodore. She also indulges her passions for running and baking delicious cookies.

item.title: Our Services
item.content:encoded:
Our Services

  • Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy

    Conditions we commonly treat:

    • Musculoskeletal and sporting injuries: Sprains, strains, muscle tears, tendonitis, overuse injuries, and more.

    • Pregnancy and postnatal aches and pains: Back pain, pelvic pain, diastasis recti, and post-delivery discomfort.

    • Back and neck pain: From acute stiffness to chronic discomfort, we create self management plans for long term support

    • Joint pain: Whether arthritis, auto-immue, or another issue, we help restore mobility and reduce inflammation.

    • Chronic pain: Our holistic approach manages pain and empowers you to take control of your life.

    • Post surgical care: Support your recovery process after surgery with customized physiotherapy programs.

    Services we offer:

    • Comprehensive assessments: We understand your unique needs and goals to craft the perfect treatment plan.

    • Manual therapy: Massage, joint mobilization, and cupping to address muscle tension and improve joint range of motion.

    • Dry needling: Precisely target trigger points for pain relief and muscle activation.

    • Taping: Support your body and enhance athletic performance or move with less discomfort

    • Personalised exercise programs: Strengthen, stabilize, and improve flexibility with tailored exercises.

    • Education and self-management tools: Empower yourself to maintain optimal health and prevent future issues.

  • Exercise Physiology

    Conditions we commonly treat:

    Injury rehabilitation

    Injury prevention

    Prenatal and Postnatal exercise

    Chronic pain and disease management

    Osteoporosis and healthy ageing

    Musculoskeletal and Neurological rehabilitation

    Strength and Conditioning

    Athletic performance

    What to Expect:

    During your initial consultation, we will take the time to understand your medical history, current fitness level, and specific health concerns. A detailed physical assessment will follow to evaluate your movement patterns, strength, and flexibility. This thorough approach ensures that we develop a safe and effective exercise plan just for you.

    Treatment may include:

    Exercise Guidelines: Personalized advice on how to incorporate exercise into your daily routine safely and effectively.

    Pilates: A focus on core strength, flexibility, and overall body awareness to enhance your physical health.

    Functional and Resistance Training: Exercises designed to improve your strength, endurance, and ability to perform everyday activities with ease.

    Coaching: One-on-one support and motivation to help you achieve your fitness and health goals.

    Home Exercises and Gym Programs: Customized exercise routines that can be performed at home or in the gym, tailored to your specific needs.

    Injury Rehabilitation: Targeted exercises to aid recovery and prevent future injuries.

    Injury Prevention: Strategies and exercises to reduce the risk of future injuries.

    Chronic Pain and Disease Management: Specialized programs to manage conditions like arthritis, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease through exercise.

    Osteoporosis and Healthy Ageing: Exercises to strengthen bones, improve balance, and promote healthy ageing.

    Musculoskeletal and Neurological Rehabilitation: Programs designed to improve movement and function for those with musculoskeletal or neurological conditions.

    Strength and Conditioning & Athletic Performance: Tailored programs to enhance athletic performance and overall physical conditioning.

  • Pilates & Small Group Classes

    Our clinic is equipped with:

    Reformer, Wunda Chair, Trapeze Table, CoreAlign, free weights and much more

    Our classes are perfect for:

    Strength and conditioning, injury rehab, pilates lovers, pre/postnatal, healthy aging and for family training

    Pre-class assessment required prior to commencing classes. Claimable with private health. Classes have a maximum of 4 people and are 45mins in duration.

  • Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy

    Conditions we commonly treat: 

    • Incontinence (urine or bowel)

    • Prolapse

    • Pelvic pain (such as endometriosis, vulvodynia, vaginismus etc )

    • Diastasis recti (abdominal separation)

    • Pre- and postnatal care

    • Sexual dysfunction

    • Menopause care. 

    What to Expect: During your initial consultation your physiotherapist will discuss your medical history and concerns. They will then perform a comprehensive assessment (potentially a vaginal examination if deemed necessary) to determine the best course of treatment.

    Treatment may include:

    • Education about pelvic floor anatomy and function

    • Exercises to strengthen and retrain the pelvic floor muscles

    • Biofeedback to improve muscle awareness

    • Manual therapy

    • Electrical stimulation

item.content:encoded:
Clinic Update June 2025

Wow – that was a jam-packed first half of the year! Here's a little update on some exciting changes and upcoming happenings in the studio.

Nicole’s Leave Update

As some of you already know, Nicole is heading off for a well-earned break!

  • Last day in clinic: Friday, 27th June

  • Return to clinic: Monday, 4th August

During this time, Laura will be increasing her hours to keep things running smoothly.

Laura’s work hours - July

Monday

  • 6am-3pm on 30th June & 7th July

  • 8 am – 3 pm for the remaining Mondays in July

Wednesday: 6 am – 1 pm

Thursday: 6 am – 2 pm

Class timetable - July

Unfortunately no PM classes will be available, so if you need a home exercise program to keep you going during July please pop your name down on the program request form.

Laura will have the clinic phone so send all appointment requests there. Any other concerns, please email admin@embracemovementclinic.com.au

New Equipment in the Studio!

As many of you have noticed, we’ve said goodbye to our very first piece of equipment and welcomed a BRAND NEW reformer and reformer-trapeze combo!

To help keep everything fresh, clean, and long-lasting, we kindly ask:

  • Preferably NO sneakers on the new equipment.

  • Grip socks preferred for hygiene and longevity

    • (Forgot yours? No worries—grip socks are available in the studio for $15, or feel free to bring your hospital or trampoline socks).

  • Need orthotics during your session? Sneakers are fine—just let us know so we can adjust the setup for you.

  • There is a shoe rack outside to minimise the dirt coming in

Online Bookings

Want to save time and avoid creating new profiles every time you book? Ask Nicole or Laura for your unique online booking code for quicker booking.

AI Tools Trial

We’re trialing healthcare-specific AI tools to help streamline admin and enhance your care. These are used for note efficiency, sending summary emails, and drafting documents/letters. 

No private or identifying info is shared externally, and everything is reviewed by your practitioner. The tools simply help us reduce the administration burden and free up more time to support quality care. If you would like further information please let us know.

Saturday Sessions - Surprise Appointments!

Need a weekend appointment? Nicole will occasionally open up Saturday appointments for physiotherapy or private exercise. These aren't regularly scheduled. If you’d like to be notified when Saturday appointments are available, opt-in to our SMS notification list by popping your name down here

We’d Love Your Input

Please take a moment to complete our short feedback survey. We are constantly trying to improve our services and we would love to know your thoughts. Complete the Google Forms survey here: https://forms.gle/jxFKrfqM7K6sCzsw5

Thank you for being such an amazing part of our Embrace Movement community. We’re here to support you moving well and living well—see you in the clinic soon!

Healthy regards,

Nicole & Laura

item.title: Vestibular Physiotherapy
item.content:encoded:
Vestibular Physiotherapy

Vestibular physiotherapy is a specialised form of physiotherapy aimed at treating disorders of the inner ear which play a crucial role in balance, spatial orientation, and coordination. These include; vertigo, dizziness and decreased balance. The most common type of condition is Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

A physiotherapy appointment will include a comprehensive assessment to diagnose the specific vestibular disorder then, an individualised treatment plan is designed.

Treatment may include:

  • Movements to dislodge the crystals of the inner ear and restore them to the correct location.

  • Techniques to enhance visual focus and reduce dizziness during head movements.

  • Repetitive movements that provoke symptoms to help the brain adapt and reduce sensitivity.

  • Information about the vestibular disorder, strategies to manage symptoms, and advice on lifestyle modification.

Vestibular physiotherapy is evidence-based and has been shown to be effective in managing and improving symptoms associated with vestibular disorders, helping patients regain functional independence and confidence in their daily lives. Book appointments with Laura if requiring vestibular physiotherapy treatment.

item.content:encoded:
Clinic Update December 2024

Dear Valued Clients,

We hope this newsletter finds you in good health and high spirits! As we rapidly approach Christmas and the New Year we have some updates to share with you.

A Heartfelt Thank You

First of all, as we reflect on the past year, we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude for your ongoing support towards our small business. We sincerely appreciate you choosing Embrace Movement Clinic and continuing to refer family and friends to us. It means so much to us that you choose to support a small business and trust us with your healthcare needs. Your trust and loyalty are truly appreciated!

Group Exercise Rehabilitation Classes Update
Our group exercise rehabilitation classes are gaining momentum and getting busier! These classes are designed to enhance your recovery and promote overall strength and wellness in a supportive environment. We encourage you to secure your preferred ongoing timeslot for 2025. By letting us know, we can prebook you in from December. 

Cancellation Policy Reminder
Please remember to give us 24 hours notice for any cancellations. This helps us accommodate other clients to get off the waitlist. 

Socks/footwear

When participating in Group exercise classes we ask that you please wear Pilates socks for hygiene reasons as well as to reduce wear on the Pilates equipment. We will have more stock available  for 2025. We understand at times enclosed footwear with orthotics need to be worn when exercising and we are happy to support this. 

Class Packages Available

We also want to remind you that class packages are available. They’re a fantastic way to stay committed, save money, and allow you to get away quickly after class. Plus, remember that you can still claim on your health fund even if you purchase a package! 10 x small group exercise classes = $350

Refer a Friend in January
In January, we invite you to refer a friend to our clinic. As a thank you for spreading the word, you’ll receive a free group class! It’s a great way to share the benefits of our services with someone you care about.

Important Dates
Please note that the last day the clinic is open for 2024 is Friday, December 20th as we take a break for Christmas. We will resume normal operations on Monday, January 6th. We look forward to seeing you in 2025.

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy and Healthy New Year,

Nicole, Laura and Jeff.
